executiveSummary.narrative: Q4 2025 demonstrated strong growth across key visibility metrics. Total views increased significantly driven by exceptional growth in desktop maps visibility (+43% QoQ, +712% YoY). Customer actions remained robust with direction requests up 17% quarter-over-quarter.

highlights.title: Outstanding Maps Growth
highlights.description: Desktop maps impressions surged 712% year-over-year, indicating significantly improved local search visibility.

highlights.title: Strong Action Growth
highlights.description: Website clicks increased 85% quarter-over-quarter, showing improved engagement and conversion potential.

highlights.title: Robust Direction Requests
highlights.description: Direction requests grew 17% QoQ and 30% YoY, demonstrating strong intent to visit locations.

highlights.title: Consistent Review Performance
highlights.description: Average rating maintained at 4.3 stars with 68% positive sentiment across all review platforms.

insights: Desktop maps views drove 60% of total impressions, up from 35% last quarter
Direction requests show strong purchase intent with +17% QoQ growth
Phone calls declined 3% QoQ but remain 5% above prior year levels
Engagement rate improved 22% QoQ, outperforming industry benchmarks
Reach expanded to 890K users, a 25% YoY increase
Post clicks up 18% indicating stronger content resonance
Discovery views grew steadily at 8% QoQ across all locations
Website clicks from Apple Maps increased 15% YoY
Direction requests indicate growing iOS user base engagement
Branded searches account for 52% of impressions, indicating strong brand awareness
Discovery keywords grew 15% YoY, showing expanding market reach
Navigational searches suggest loyal customer base returning via direct search
Customer service consistently praised with 89 positive mentions
Wait times flagged as key improvement area with 45 negative mentions
Value perception strong with 56 positive mentions on pricing

recentHighlights.text: Great products but parking was difficult
Will definitely come back. Highly recommend!

recommendations.title: Optimize Google Business Profile Descriptions
recommendations.description: Update location descriptions with high-performing discovery keywords identified in the keyword analysis. Focus on 'location analytics' and 'local seo software' terms.
recommendations.impact: Projected 10-15% increase in discovery search visibility

recommendations.title: Increase Facebook Post Frequency
recommendations.description: Current engagement rates suggest audience appetite for more content. Recommend increasing from 3 to 5 posts per week with focus on local community content.

recommendations.title: Enable Apple Maps Enhanced Listings
recommendations.description: Several locations lack complete Apple Maps profiles. Adding photos, business hours, and services can improve discovery rates.
recommendations.impact: Potential 25% increase in Apple Maps actions

dataSources: Google Business Profile via PinMeTo API
Apple Maps Connect via PinMeTo API

reportingPeriod.lagNote: Google data has approximately 10-day reporting lag. Data for late December may be incomplete.

calculationNotes: YoY (Year-over-Year) comparisons use Q4 2024 as the baseline
QoQ (Quarter-over-Quarter) comparisons use Q3 2025 as the baseline
Percentage changes calculated as: ((current - previous) / previous) × 100
Average ratings are weighted by review count across locations
Keyword categories assigned based on brand name presence and search intent
